recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future regressions should be handled in the validator repository; new narrative guidance about risk-adjustment reports without computable Measure groups should be raised as a separate CQI/FHIR-I wording issue if desired.
issue_request: FHIR-34175 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that publisher validation only compare MeasureReport.group codes to Measure.group codes when the referenced Measure has groups, so risk-adjustment reports can carry HCC-code groups even when the Measure has no computable groups.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the PR was approved and merged. The cited hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core#630 PR merged on 2021-11-03 and added an early return in MeasureValidator.validateMeasureReportGroups when m.groups().size() == 0. No HL7/fhir source commit for FHIR-34175 was found.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current MeasureReport source includes descriptive group and group.code correspondence guidance, and later FHIR-49670 clarified report population expectations for defined Measure groups, but the old publisher validation rule itself lives in the external validator codebase.
reconciliation: No HL7/fhir source was changed. The combined branch now contains an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the requested validator behavior was applied in the external HAPI FHIR validator repository.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied R6 CQI issue clarified Measure-to-MeasureReport correspondence for defined groups, populations, stratifiers, and supplementalData; it informs interpretation but is not the validator relaxation requested by FHIR-34175.
R5 issue added linkId to Measure and MeasureReport to support explicit correspondence when Measure groups are present.
